messages:
Alex Carter: Heads-up — opening a 90m change window for payment-network cutover (network + IAM TF apply). Need to pin tfvars/module refs and agree rollback criteria. Any blockers?

Deploybot: scheduled check: preflight terraform plan will run in 10m. If plan has >1 destructive resource, it will pause.

Sam Wu: I can run the canary apply to staging first. Who will run prod?

Alex Carter: Sam, +1 for staging. I'll handoff prod apply to whoever is on infra oncall (preferably someone with tfstate access).

Priya Nair: Reminder: release-notes need the network changes + the iam_role ARN. Also add explicit rollback steps and the owner for the revert.

Irene Gomez: What are the exact pins? please paste tfvar snippet so release notes can reference them.

Alex Carter: Pasting minimal tfvar + module pin we plan to use:
```
# modules/network/main.tf
module "vpc_peers" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood-infra/modules.git//networking/vpc_peering?ref=release/2026-03-17-abc123"
}

# terraform.tfvars.json
{
  "vpc_peering_id": "peer-0a1b2c3d4e",
  "iam_role_arn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-network-apply"
}
```

Alex Carter: Rollback plan (short):
- Canary in staging at +10m.
- If staging plan or apply produces >0 destructive changes to shared subnets, abort and roll back.
- Prod apply: monitor 5m buckets for 502/504 spike >2% or route-flap alerts. If triggered, run rollback: update module ref back to previous commit and `terraform apply -var-file=rollback.tfvars.json` from ops runbook.

Sam Wu: Sounds good. Can we add a quick smoke check after prod apply? i.e. synthetic requests to payment endpoints + healthcheck of VPC routes.

Priya Nair: I'll add the smoke tests and the rollback commands to the release notes. Also adding the specific contact list (netops + platform-sre).

ops-bot: @channel Reminder: create a canary release tag in release tracker and link the run id after apply.

Irene Gomez: One more ask — pin provider version in the workspace to avoid surprises during apply. Add to workspace: `required_providers { aws = { version = "~> 5.0" } }`

Alex Carter: Good call. We'll pin provider and module refs. I'll push a small commit to the infra repo with the pinned provider and tfvars lock. Sam, can you confirm you have access to prod tfstate and the rollback runbook link?

Sam Wu: I do. I also put a short checklist in the thread for the operator to follow during prod apply.

Deploybot: Preflight result: plan OK (no accidental destroys). Canary job queued as job_id=jt-9571, scheduled in 8m.

Alex Carter: Assigning @Sam Wu for staging canary. @Irene Gomez please be standby for quick rollback if needed. Priya to update release notes before prod.

Priya Nair: Updated release notes section and pasted smoke test commands. Will ping ops channel once prod is complete. :thumbsup:

Sam Wu: Running staging canary now. Will post plan + apply logs here.

(5m later)
Sam Wu: staging canary apply succeeded. smoke tests pass (0 errors). logs: https://ci.internal/reports/jt-9571

Alex Carter: Great. Moving to prod in 20m. Locking tfvars and tagging the infra commit.

ops-bot: Job scheduled for prod apply: job_id=jt-9572, owner=Sam Wu, eta=20m. Automated rollback watch enabled.

Irene Gomez: Oncall alerted. I'll watch route flaps and 502s; will trigger rollback if thresholds hit.

Alex Carter: Final: if prod apply goes clean, we will remove canary flag and update release notes with commit + run ids. If rollback happens, we'll open a post-incident and revert module refs.

Sam Wu: Ready. :eyes:

Deploybot: Prod apply started (jt-9572). Will stream logs into the thread.

(6m later)
Deploybot: Prod apply finished: success. No destructive changes. run_id=jt-9572.

Priya Nair: Pushed final release notes with run links and rollback steps. tagging #release-announce after QA signoff. :tada:

Alex Carter: Thanks everyone. Closing the change window in 30m and marking infra commit pinned to release/2026-03-17-abc123. :lock:
